scripts.test:api: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:regression
scripts.test:data: newman run collections/Restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e env/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder 06-Data-Driven -d data/booking-cases.json -r cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/data.html --reporter-htmlextra-logs --reporter-json-export reports/data.json --suppress-exit-code && node scripts/check-known-issues.js --report reports/data.json --data data/booking-cases.json
scripts.test:data-patch: newman run collections/Restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e env/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder 07-Data-Driven-Patch -d data/patch-cases.json -r cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/data-patch.html --reporter-htmlextra-logs --reporter-json-export reports/data-patch.json --suppress-exit-code && node scripts/check-known-issues.js --report reports/data-patch.json --data data/patch-cases.json --targets "PATCH,수정 후 재조회"
